$schema_note: Modeled workflow estimates for scripts/measure_skill_context.py. Each workflow is an explicit, hand-maintained file list reconciled against the SKILL.md/rules routing that exists at the time this file was last edited — it is not derived by following Markdown links or by crawling directories, and it does not by itself prove what a real session actually loads. Update it when a skill's routing changes; the script will report drift between this file's own last edit and the skills/ tree's current revision, but cannot detect a routing change that silently makes a listed file stale or a real file missing from this list.
excluded_external: Laravel Boost's laravel-best-practices, testing-best-practices, and inertia-vue-development skills — real cost when installed, not published in this repository, not measurable here.
The artifact-design skill that document-it/SKILL.md requires loading before writing any Artifact page — same caveat.
Application/project code, prior conversation history, and tool-call output (command results, diffs, search results) for every workflow.
excluded_project_docs: docs/skill-authoring-methodology.md and docs/skill-consumption.md serve a skill's author or a project's installer, not a running pipeline workflow — no SKILL.md or rule file in skills/ references either one.

workflows.name: review-it: standalone review
workflows.notes: All three rule files are consulted on essentially every invocation, in the order SKILL.md's own Rules list states.

workflows.name: lab-it: investigation-and-answer only
workflows.notes: rules/plan-synthesis.md loads only for the 'Plan feature architecture' workflow; a plain investigation-and-answer request never reaches it.

workflows.name: document-it: new Markdown guide, evidence already sufficient
workflows.notes: lab-it not routed to because evidence is already sufficient and current.

workflows.name: document-it: new Artifact guide
workflows.notes: Same as the Markdown-guide row, plus the Artifact scaffold. The external artifact-design skill this requires is not counted (excluded_external).

workflows.name: document-it: reconcile existing Markdown guide, evidence routed through lab-it (cross-skill)
workflows.notes: rules/maintenance.md routes to rules/doc-style.md for how a connected change gets written. rules/template.html is not reached because this is a Markdown, not an Artifact, guide.

workflows.name: plan-it: one resource/CRUD feature, UI in scope, single shape
workflows.notes: rules/capability-checklist.md, rules/plan-md-input.md, and rules/discovered-work.md are the unused alternates for this shape.

workflows.name: plan-it: same feature, mixed characteristics (secondary checklist)
workflows.notes: rules/feature-classification.md's own 'secondary questions' allowance adds rules/capability-checklist.md on top of the single-shape row.

workflows.name: implement-it: one ordinary issue, no stack companion, no isolation, no reconstruction (cross-skill review-it call before Gate 1)
workflows.notes: The ordinary path per implement-it/SKILL.md's current Rules list. isolation-verification.md, worktree-preservation.md, and commit-reconstruction.md are not loaded on this path.

workflows.name: implement-it: same issue, isolation verification triggered (no reconstruction)
workflows.notes: verification.md's own criteria for an intermediate committed state needing proof, without a review correction folding into an already-committed, unpublished commit.

workflows.name: implement-it: same issue, unpublished-history reconstruction
workflows.notes: commit-reconstruction.md mandates isolation verification for every rebuilt commit (its own step 11).

workflows.name: implement-it: ordinary issue composed with laravel-inertia-stack for one filtered-index task (cross-skill)
workflows.notes: blueprints/filters-and-sorting.md's own 'Testing' section routes further to rules/test-ownership.md and blueprints/pest-testing.md; its 'Naming and location' section cites rules/php-conventions.md for the abstract-base-class/final-subclass convention.

workflows.name: ship-it: PR readiness and authorized creation, local files only
workflows.notes: Local-file subtotal only. milestone-pr-readiness.md's own citation into milestone-completion.md's shared guidance is conditional (a manual-testing finding needing scope interpretation, or confirming Backlog eligibility) — see the 'broader estimate' row below for when that citation is actually followed.

workflows.name: ship-it: PR readiness, broader estimate (shared guidance actually consulted)
workflows.notes: Adds rules/milestone-completion.md when the pass actually follows milestone-pr-readiness.md's own citation into it.

workflows.name: ship-it: CI-failure investigation and correction handoff
workflows.notes: Step 3 of ci-failure-correction.md unconditionally directs consulting implement-it/rules/review-gates.md's 'when to stop and ask' standard, so that file is mandatory for this path, not merely conditional.

workflows.name: ship-it: full delivery happy path (readiness -> creation -> closure -> release, no CI failure)
workflows.notes: Already includes milestone-completion.md, so the PR-readiness row's own broader-estimate distinction does not add anything further here.
